summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespaces, without running any tests (per instructions; verified by reading only). Changes in rdflib/namespace.py: Namespace.__contains__(ref) returns ref.startswith(self) (prefix test, reference as receiver); ClosedNamespace.__contains__(ref) returns any(ref == uri for uri in self.__uris.values()), using node-type-aware equality, inherited by _RDFNamespace; _ipython_key_completions_ now returns dir(self.uri). Changes in test/test_namespace.py: added test_namespace_prefix_membership, test_closed_namespace_membership_rdfs (positive, undefined-term negative, plain string and Literal negatives), and test_closed_namespace_membership_rdf (positive RDF.type, container _1 negative); imports extended with RDF, RDFS, Namespace, Literal. Nothing committed. Not run: the test suite and doctests are unverified.
